title: SATURDAY NIGHT BINGO
seo_title: Black Saturday BINGO with Food Drive
description: Black Saturday BINGO is a night of BINGO games and pull-tabs with cash prizes, held after Thanksgiving and shopping. Wear black to get $5 off a 9-pack (limit 1 per person); the kitchen offers bean and beef burritos and nachos on special, and the bar serves adult beverages. If 70 or more players attend, two extra games with an additional $100 will be raised, and you can bring non-perishable food for the Annual Food Drive through December 31 to benefit local food pantries.
venue: American Legion Howard S. Keeling Post 138
address: 1424 W Broadway St,Bolivar,MO,United States, Bolivar, MO
